messages:
marta-sales: Heads up 10 Zenpointe POC stuck. Customer requires BYO-KMS attestation + committed pricing tiers before exec signoff. Need triage.
leo-se: Can someone drop their security questionnaire? Ill map answers.
marta-sales: Link in drive: https://zenpointe.example/sec-q.pdf. Key asks: BYO-KMS w/ HSM attestation, 7y audit retention, regional egress, 99.9% p99 SLA.
anya-eng: Their test load: ~1.1k concurrent sessions, avg seq 480. To hit p99 we'll want Dedicated + pinned model and batching rules.
carl-ops: BYO-KMS requires peering + customer IAM principal + IP allowlist. Ops wants a feature flag for any automatic KMS fallback.
sophia-ciso: We'll need HSM cert chain and a short diagram proving separation of keys from our control plane. Legal + infra artifacts required.
nina-legal: I can draft the attestation addendum. Need a 1-page infra note from eng/ops describing KMS proxying and logs.
dylan-fin: Finance can propose committed discounts: baseline 18-22% for 12mo, additional rebate for sustained >1k qps. Will share table.
bridge-bot: Exec bridge created: #exec-zenpointe-bridge 2026-07-08 18:00 UTC.
marta-sales: Action list: 1) Leo 0 finalize sec answers. 2) Anya/Carl 0 infra diagram + runbook + flag. 3) Nina 0 addendum draft. 4) Dylan 0 pricing table. Post links before bridge.
leo-se: Will post the Q&A doc by EOD.
anya-eng: Diagram + sample config (allowlist + kms_endpoint) by EOD.
carl-ops: Runbook + feature-flag metric (kms.failover_count) PR tomorrow AM.
nina-legal: Addendum first pass tomorrow midday.
dylan-fin: Pricing table by tomorrow afternoon.
sophia-ciso: Note: do not promise SLA on Hosted variants. Recommend 99.9% p99 only on Dedicated pinned config.
marta-sales: Perfect. I'll prep the exec deck. If we clear these items pre-bridge we should remove the blocker. :thumbsup:
